title: Ribasim v2026.1.1 physical versus allocation low-storage factor on the same accepted state

sequencing.rationale: Freeze the direct forecast-versus-realization state-factor comparison before observing DUMMY-20H3.

observed_states: physical infiltration derivative after water_balance! on the same t=0 state
hypotheses: At initial Basin level 1.0 m and area 1e6 m2, the physical state-derived low-storage factor is approximately 1 because storage is far above the configured low-storage threshold.
The physical water-balance formulation therefore represents approximately the full 7.9999147 m3/day infiltration on that same t=0 state.
If DUMMY-20H3 qualifies, the allocation LP factor for the identical state and forcing is approximately 0 while root allocation remains 32 m3/day.
The physical and allocation factors are therefore distinct state semantics, not two observations of one common reduction factor.
The mismatch is a forecast-realization seam for externally imposed Basin infiltration under this topology and priority configuration.
forbidden: no claim that LP alpha should universally equal the physical factor
do not execute as authority if DUMMY-20H3 does not qualify
